title: hieracium vulgatum subsp. brevidentatum
intro: Hieracium vulgatum subsp. brevidentatum, commonly known as lesser hawk's-beard, is a plant species within the dandelion family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, including its potential to aid in reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium vulgatum subsp. brevidentatum are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
